Photo by Pascal Bernardon on Unsplash A fleet of pirates is set to storm Menomonee Falls when the Old Falls Renaissance Faire Pirate Fest drops anchor at Old Falls Village Park on September 13–14, 2025 . Just northwest of Milwaukee, this immersive weekend promises to transform the historic grounds into a raucous seaside village filled with adventure.
What to Expect at Pirate Fest Visitors can look forward to a full slate of pirate-themed activities designed for families, history buffs, and thrill-seekers alike:
Pirate encampments and swordplay reenactments that bring the high seas to life. Live maritime music from fan-favorite group Bounding Main , filling the air with shanties and sea songs. Treasure hunts and scavenger activities tailored to kids and the young-at-heart. Artisan vendors and costume contests where attendees can shop, dress, and play the part. A themed Biergarten offering hearty food and frothy grog for hungry adventurers. The festival is hosted by the Friends of Old Falls Village , known for preserving the 17-acre historical park, and has been highlighted by outlets like Milwaukee With Kids and The Renlist .
Why It’s Worth the Voyage Whether you’re a casual fair-goer or a diehard Ren Faire fan, Pirate Fest stands out by combining Renaissance tradition with seafaring mischief. The family-friendly setting means kids can embark on treasure quests while adults enjoy the Biergarten—or join in the costumed revelry themselves.
With Menomonee Falls just a short drive from Milwaukee, it’s an easy weekend getaway into a world of sword clashes, sea songs, and swashbuckling spectacle.
